model_specification.threshold_policy: DEFAULT_0.5_UNSEEN (No threshold tuning permitted on held-out split)

dataset_availability_audit.blocker_description: No external independent clinical radiograph test split (e.g., VinDr-CXR, BRAX, or private authenticated PACS split) is mounted in the repository environment.

patient_level_leakage_audit.tooling: scripts/validate_xray_dataset.py (Phase 7.6 hardened with SHA-256 duplicate image detection and pretraining overlap auditing)

PLEURAL_EFFUSION.interpretation: Pleural space fluid attenuation, blunted costophrenic angles

ATELECTASIS.interpretation: Subsegmental or lobar volume loss / collapse

CONSOLIDATION.interpretation: Alveolar airspace opacification with air bronchograms

EDEMA.interpretation: Diffuse pulmonary vascular congestion, Kerley B lines

PNEUMOTHORAX.interpretation: Visceral pleural line, absent peripheral lung markings

INFILTRATION.interpretation: Ill-defined parenchymal opacity (historically non-standard per Fleischner)

PNEUMONIA.interpretation: Infective alveolar infiltrate (requires clinical symptom correlation)

PLEURAL_THICKENING.interpretation: Apical capping or non-dependent pleural thickening

tier_1_software_correctness.evidence: Pytest suite passed 97/97 tests; Tier 1 calculation harness verified AUROC, AUPRC, Sensitivity, Specificity, F1, ECE, Brier score, and Bootstrap 95% CIs.

tier_2_held_out_benchmark.evidence: No external independent clinical radiograph test split mounted. Strict non-fabrication rule enforced.

tier_4_clinical_validation.evidence: Assistive CDSS software only. Uncalibrated probabilistic scores; mandatory clinician verification required.

actionable_next_steps: Mount an ethically approved, de-identified independent external evaluation split (e.g. VinDr-CXR test partition, CheXpert held-out 500-study radiologist consensus split, or licensed PACS cohort).
Execute `python scripts/validate_xray_dataset.py --manifest-csv <path> --image-root <dir>` to verify zero patient-level leakage and SHA-256 duplicate isolation.

Execute `python scripts/evaluate_xray_model.py --model-id XRAY_PYTORCH_DENSENET121_V1 --dataset-csv <path> --image-root <dir> --output-json artifacts/xray/phase7.6/held_out_results.json` to compute genuine test set metrics.
